notes: CDER CGMP letter based on a section 704(a)(4) records review (no on-site inspection), so location_contains is null per the 704(a)(4) precedent (e.g. tianjin-kilo, sante-manufacturing, respilon-production). Findings concern talc-containing OTC drug products: inadequate QU oversight of asbestos-in-talc identity testing at a contract lab (suspicious IR spectral data raising data-integrity concerns), and release of a talc lot that failed identity specifications. All drug/ingredient names are redacted as (b)(4), so products is empty and product_redacted is true. contamination_present is false because the letter describes inadequate/questionable asbestos testing methodology, not a confirmed asbestos detection. recall_concern is true given the request for retain-sample identity/assay/impurity testing of implicated talc lots and a three-year retrospective review of components used in U.S. products (assess-distributed).
